author: Internal Research — Semis
title: Data-center demand still outrunning supply, but position size is the risk
summary: Hyperscaler capex guidance for the next four quarters remains above consensus, supporting continued revenue growth. Our concern is not the thesis but concentration: the position has roughly tripled since purchase and now dominates single-stock risk in the taxable account. We favour trimming into strength rather than adding.

author: Internal Research — Consumer Tech
title: Services mix keeps margins resilient; hardware cycle is the swing factor
summary: Services now contribute the majority of gross profit, which cushions the slower device cycle. Valuation is full relative to expected growth. We see it as a quality core holding but not a candidate for adding at current prices.

author: Internal Research — Energy
title: Cash flow supports the dividend, but price is a function of crude
summary: Break-even costs have fallen after the Permian consolidation, so the dividend looks well covered even in a lower-crude scenario. The equity remains highly correlated to oil prices, so treat it as a diversifier against inflation rather than a growth position.

author: Internal Research — Fixed Income
title: Aggregate bonds finally earning their keep
summary: With the yield to maturity comfortably above inflation, core bonds are once again a reasonable ballast. Duration risk is moderate. For portfolios below their bond target, this is the simplest instrument to close the gap.

author: Internal Research — Digital Assets
title: Keep the crypto sleeve small and rebalance mechanically
summary: Bitcoin's volatility remains several times that of equities. The ETF wrapper removes custody risk but not price risk. Our house view is a 1-5% sleeve, rebalanced on a schedule rather than on conviction, and always held in a tax-advantaged account to avoid short-term-gain drag.

author: Internal Research — Global Equity
title: International valuations offer a margin of safety
summary: Developed ex-US markets trade at a meaningful discount to the US on both earnings and book value, and currency exposure has helped rather than hurt this year. We continue to recommend holding international at or slightly above target weight.

author: Internal Research — Consumer Staples
title: Best-in-class operator, priced like it
summary: Membership renewal rates and traffic remain exceptional, but the multiple leaves little room for disappointment. Hold; do not add above the current range.

author: Internal Research — Income Strategies
title: A dividend tilt that does not sacrifice quality
summary: The fund's quality and yield screens have produced lower drawdowns than the broad market with a yield roughly three times that of the total-market index. Suitable for investors who want income in a taxable account, given the qualified-dividend treatment.

author: Internal Research — Semis
title: The indispensable foundry, with geopolitical tail risk
summary: Leading-edge capacity is effectively sold out through next year. The discount to US peers reflects geopolitical risk that cannot be diversified away within the stock. Size any position accordingly.

author: Internal Research — Financials
title: Fortress balance sheet; watch credit costs into a slower economy
summary: Net interest income has plateaued and provisions are creeping higher, but capital return remains strong. A reasonable hold with a dependable dividend.
